newsitem.title: CHILE: Quake near Chile Zaldivar copper mine, no damage.
newsitem.headline: Quake near Chile Zaldivar copper mine, no damage.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 4.8 degrees on the Richter scale shook the region near the Zaldivar copper mine on Monday but no injuries or damages were reported, Chile's National Office of Emergencies (ONEMI) said.
Minera Zaldivar is jointly owned by Finland's Outokumpu Oy and Canada's Placer Dome. A spokesman for the mining company was not immediately available for comment.
Onemi said the tremor was also felt in the coastal city of Antofagasta, 1,400 km (875 miles) north of Santiago. Zaldivar is about 170 km (105 miles) east of Antofagasta.
